subject: maths
question: Selling price of an article is Rs. 1184 and discount of 26 percent is offered. What is the marked price of the article?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of an article = Rs. 1184

Discount offered = 26%

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price = Selling Price / (1 - Discount Rate)

**Calculation:**

Discount Rate = 26% = 26/100 = 0.26

Marked Price = Selling Price / (1 - Discount Rate)

⇒ Marked Price = 1184 / (1 - 0.26)

⇒ Marked Price = 1184 / 0.74

⇒ Marked Price = 1600

**The marked price of the article is Rs. 1600.**
